## Why This Is Asked

This question evaluates practical Databricks expertise in multi-tenant data architectures, specifically testing knowledge of CDC implementation with Change Data Feed, governance controls, and enterprise-grade data pipeline design. - **Watermarking**: Technique for managing late-arriving data in streaming contexts

- **Data Quality Gates**: Validation checkpoints ensuring data integrity before downstream consumption

## Testing Strategy

Testing should validate pipeline behavior under various failure scenarios, schema changes, and data quality conditions to ensure production readiness and reliability.

## Why This Is Asked
Explores robust dedup when event identifiers are missing, multi-source integration, late data handling, and tenant isolation without reworking RBAC.

## Key Concepts
- Composite-key dedup with MERGE and windowing
- Watermark-based late data processing
- Delta constraints for schema drift
- Tenant isolation via dynamic views (no RBAC changes)
- Lightweight synthetic-data tests for drift and QC

## Code Example
```sql
MERGE INTO silver AS s
USING (
  SELECT user_id, event_ts, MAX(event_seq) AS seq
  FROM bronze
  GROUP BY user_id, event_ts
) AS b
ON s.user_id = b.user_id AND s.event_ts = b.event_ts
WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET s.seq = b.seq
WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (user_id, event_ts, seq) VALUES (b.user_id, b.event_ts, b.seq);
```

